title: EEG data from an auditory oddball task
description: EEG recordings from an auditory oddball task collected at the Meditation Research Institute in Rishikesh, India. Participants completed three 13-minute sessions with standard tones, oddball tones and white-noise distractors, with eyes closed, and responded to oddballs with a keypress. The dataset supports study of auditory event-related potentials such as the P300.
methods_description: Data were recorded with an Active Two Biosemi system at 1024 Hz using 10-20 standard caps. Each of three sessions presented 750 stimuli (70% standard 500 Hz tones, 15% oddball 1000 Hz tones, 15% white-noise distractors) at about 1 per second with Gaussian jitter. Stimuli were presented with the Psychophysics Toolbox in MATLAB. Raw data were resampled to 256 Hz with the Biosemi tool and converted to EEGLAB format.
